name: Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd
summary: Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd, through its subsidiaries, engages in the insurance, consumer credit, real estate, and financial services in Israel. It also provides car, property, life, and health insurance products; mortgages; car loans; and real estate solutions, such as office spaces and co-working environments. In addition, the company offers general, life insurance and savings, personal disability, compulsory car, motor vehicle property, medical expenses and hospitalization, personal accident, critical illness, overseas travel, and other health insurance products.
